start: HQ app, one active gym open

steps.action: Suspend the gym with a reason
user_sees: The gym's status suspended with the time

steps.action: Open the audit log
user_sees: A row 'suspend_gym' with the reason, from active to suspended

start: HQ app, one gym open

steps.action: Suspend with a reason of 2 letters
user_sees: Refused: a reason is needed

steps.action: Set the status to 'trial'
user_sees: Refused
must_not: The gym set back to trial

start: HQ app, a suspended gym, and a new trial gym

steps.action: Restore the suspended gym
user_sees: Status active; audit row 'restore_gym'

steps.action: Approve the trial gym
user_sees: Status active; audit row 'approve_gym'
must_not: The approval logged as a restore

start: A gym HQ suspended

steps.action: The owner opens 'MettleUp access'
user_sees: The status and the suspend with its reason and time
must_not: The pause hidden from the owner

start: Admin app of a suspended gym

steps.action: Sign in and open the members list
user_sees: Sign-in works; records shown; backup download works
must_not: A sign-out or a blank list

steps.action: Add a member and save
user_sees: The save refused as the gym is paused
must_not: A success message for a save the server refused

start: Admin app of a suspended gym

steps.action: Rename the gym, change the logo colour, add a staff person, send a message, start an offer, add a shop product
user_sees: Each refused as the gym is paused

start: Admin app, gym restored by HQ

steps.action: Save the member that was refused
user_sees: The save works
must_not: Records saved on the device during the pause lost without a word

start: Admin app of a suspended gym

steps.action: Open Help and feedback, 'MettleUp access'
user_sees: The gym's status and HQ's reason
must_not: A pause with no reason given to the owner

start: Admin app at the desk of a suspended gym

steps.action: Sign in and check a member in
user_sees: Sign-in works; the check-in refused as the gym is paused

start: Admin app at the desk of a suspended gym

steps.action: Tap Give on a member 'Ready for reward' and take a payment
user_sees: Both refused as the gym is paused

start: Admin app at the desk, gym restored

steps.action: Check the member in again
user_sees: The check-in saved

steps.action: Open the app and the gym inbox
user_sees: The inbox and offers card shown

steps.action: Order from the gym shop
user_sees: The order refused

steps.action: Tap 'Join the offer'
user_sees: Join refused

steps.action: The phone sends counted days
user_sees: Days not counted

start: Member app, gym suspended, member in an offer

steps.action: Tap 'Leave the offer'

start: Member app, gym suspended

steps.action: Leave the gym from the app
user_sees: Left; number removed; offer dates deleted

start: HQ app, one active gym open; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With Gym saved by the old version, update the app, then do "HQ pauses a gym".
user_sees: The old Gym shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old Gym missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Suspend the gym with a reason
user_sees: The gym's status suspended with the time

steps.action: Open the audit log
user_sees: A row 'suspend_gym' with the reason, from active to suspended
must_not: Old Gym missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

note: gyms that existed before 0027 were set active

start: HQ app, one active gym open

steps.action: Suspend the gym with a reason
user_sees: The gym's status suspended with the time

steps.action: Do step 1 of "HQ pauses a gym" on one side (member app or gym panel); look at the same Gym on the other side.
user_sees: The other side shows the same facts, in its own words
must_not: The member and the gym seeing different facts about the Gym, or the member seeing what only the gym may see

note: admin app must show read-only at once

start: HQ app, one active gym open

steps.action: Suspend the gym with a reason
user_sees: The gym's status suspended with the time

steps.action: Tap the main button of step 1 of "HQ pauses a gym" twice, fast.
user_sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of HQ audit log, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

note: a second suspend writes a second audit row; status unchanged

start: Member app, the member's gym is suspended

steps.action: Open the app and the gym inbox
user_sees: The inbox and offers card shown

steps.action: Order from the gym shop
user_sees: The order refused

steps.action: Turn the internet off at step 2 of "HQ pauses a gym", carry on, then turn it back on.
